review.identity: bunny-alpha-2 (reviewer; same agent instance as the implementer, so this review is NOT independent - measurement semantics still want a fresh-context agent)
review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::objectives::survey_retail_objective_records over the installation (block-precedence-census.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: every mission-scoped reader archive was opened, its objectives.zrd member decoded with the production .zrd reader and its numbered OBJECTIVE<N> blocks walked per block; over 53 mission readers the installation declares 1338 objective blocks, 1091 branching declaration sites split into 1056 completion-effect sites and 35 order-dependency sites, 1465 optionality declaration sites and 24 outcome declaration sites. 270 blocks declare two or more completion effects for the same event, of which 269 name disjoint objectives, so 1 blocks contain a condition where two effects name the same objective. The isolated conditions this run found: zbd/c3/m05 OBJECTIVE8 (objective 68, WAKE then NAP first). LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-03-f39-e2-block-completion-effect-precedence.md: (1) the corpus DECLARES the effects and their targets; it does not say what any effect does, which stays an inference from the spelling; (2) the order between two effects on one objective is UNMEASURED - the record is not the program, the mission-language instruction table is unmeasured (F13-B/C, F38 own it), and the authored field order is measured not to be a format invariant, so it is recorded and never ranked; (3) the second number a NAP site carries has no measured unit and is carried as an unnamed number; (4) the census covers mission-scoped archives only. A record whose precedence is unrecovered is still refused by name, so no original mission is played and this report claims no original behaviour. `unknowns` is empty because every unresolved item above is a limit on the claim rather than an unresolved measurement: every row in the census resolved. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
